text: On XX/XX/2023 I transferred my tesla lease to another assignee. I closely followed XXXX XXXX instructions along the way. I had a XXXX car registered in XXXX. I asked Tesla whether I need to return the XXXX XXXX and tesla 's answer was no ( see attached email exchange with Tesla Finance customer service ). Fast forward to one later, I was trying to get another lease weekend and when I was updating my insurance, I realized that my NY driving license is suspended. I researched further the issue and my license suspension is related to Tesla lease transfer. As a matter of fact, my license has been suspended because of the insurance lapse resulting from the fact that Tesla instructed me to not return the license plates to XXXXXXXX XXXX
